trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [ "$#" -ge 6 ] && [ -n "$6" ]; then

    printf 'ERROR: archive collision for CUPS job %s\n' "$job_id" >&2
    exit 1

if ln "$tmp" "$target"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    printf 'INFO: archived CUPS job %s\n' "$job_id" >&2
    exit 0
fi

if [ -e "$target" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$target"; then
    exit 0
fi
printf 'ERROR: unable to commit CUPS job %s\n' "$job_id" >&2
exit 1
